meta.name: message-house-builder
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "build a message house", "write a PR-FAQ for our launch", or "define the launch narrative and value pillars"; derives from the positioning canvas a message house — tagline, one-liner, three value pillars, per-persona proof points (each labeled Measured / User-provided / [needs source]) — plus a working-backwards PR-FAQ narrative spine (launch-day tense, empty-chair test, five external + five internal FAQs) and per-channel message angle packs (angles, not finished copy). Not for the positioning canvas itself — use positioning-mapper; not for finished blog posts or pages — use content-writer; not for ad or email units — use each discipline creative builder; not for claim adjudication — use offer-claims-registry. 消息屋/PR-FAQ/价值支柱/发布叙事

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为产品发布构建消息屋、价值支柱和PR-FAQ叙事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在策划产品发布，需要统一对外沟通的核心信息
copy.tagline_en: Build a message house, value pillars, and PR-FAQ narrative for product launches
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning a product launch and need a unified core message

howto.what: 根据定位画布生成发布消息屋（标语、一句话描述、三大价值支柱、每个用户角色的证据点）、PR-FAQ叙事框架（发布日语气、五个外部和五个内部常见问题）以及各渠道消息角度包（角度而非成品文案）。
howto.when: 当用户要求“构建消息屋”、“撰写PR-FAQ”或“定义发布叙事和价值支柱”时触发。需要先有定位画布。

say.text: 为我们的新产品构建消息屋，基于定位画布。
say.note: Claude 会生成标语、价值支柱和证据点。

say.text: 为这次发布写一份PR-FAQ，发布日语气，五个外部和五个内部常见问题。
say.note: Claude 会输出新闻稿风格的叙事框架。

say.text: 将定位转化为针对Product Hunt和新闻稿的渠道消息角度。
say.note: Claude 会为每个渠道提供角度和主要证据点。

howto.what_en: Generates a message house (tagline, one-liner, three value pillars, per-persona proof points), a working-backwards PR-FAQ narrative spine (launch-day tense, five external + five internal FAQs), and per-channel message angle packs (angles, not finished copy) from a positioning canvas.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to 'build a message house', 'write a PR-FAQ', or 'define launch narrative and value pillars'. Requires an existing positioning canvas.

say_en.text: Build a message house for our new product from the positioning canvas.
say_en.note: Claude will output tagline, pillars, and proof points.

say_en.text: Write a PR-FAQ for this launch in launch-day tense with five external and five internal FAQs.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a press-release-style narrative spine.

say_en.text: Turn our positioning into per-channel message angles for Product Hunt and press.
say_en.note: Claude will provide angles and lead proof points per channel.
